input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, placed behind live 5x4 reels and interactive controls
Primary request: create one entirely original SOVEREIGN TREASURY luxury casino slot machine, a private-bank treasure vault where champagne-gold coins and gemstones are collected, with a very large clean rectangular reel aperture for a five-column four-row Cash Collect game and a compact integrated control deck
Scene/backdrop: one continuous monumental art-deco bank-vault cabinet fills the entire portrait canvas edge to edge; warm ivory marble, champagne gold ribs, ruby velvet insets, emerald glass lamps, coin channels and circular vault mechanisms; the cabinet itself continues naturally into every corner so it never looks pasted over another background
Subject: one front-facing integrated slot stage with a broad blank engraved title crest at top, a centered blank black-glass balance capsule beneath it, one dominant empty reel aperture occupying most of the middle 56 percent of the composition, a slim built-in cash-collection tray directly below the reels, and a shallow compact physical control deck with left utility recesses, paired bet minus and plus wells, one large central spin recess and one right auto recess; lower pedestal short and unobtrusive
Style/medium: high-end commercial 3D mobile casino game art, polished stylized realism, mature premium gambling atmosphere, crisp manufactured materials and coherent built-in UI architecture
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, exact orthographic front view, perfectly centered and symmetrical, full-screen cabinet with no separate scenery, all edges inside safe area, reel aperture broad and tall with straight undistorted edges, all controls visibly belong to the machine, no detached floating panels
Lighting/mood: controlled golden casino light, rich champagne reflections, gemstone sparkle, bright readable reel center, restrained bloom, premium high-stakes excitement
Color palette: champagne gold, pale gold, ivory marble, deep ruby, dark emerald glass, small sapphire and diamond-white accents; avoid dominant black, neon green or purple
Materials/textures: brushed and polished gold, ivory enamel, dark green glass, ruby velvet, faceted gemstones, engraved metal, warm marquee bulbs
Text: none
Constraints: completely blank title crest, blank balance capsule, empty warm dark-emerald reel opening with no reels or symbols, empty collection tray, clearly defined recessed control wells; no letters, numbers, currency marks, logos, watermark, characters, crown, throne, furnace, wheel, lower bonus wheel, black rectangles, black drop-shadow boxes, red flash or green chroma background
Avoid: copied casino cabinet, palace illustration, wheel-of-fortune layout, narrow reel screen, oversized lower body, detached stickers, flat vector art, sci-fi neon, illegible markings, heavy black shadows, overexposed white glare
